title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Trio #19 (ThaiBenjarong+IslamicGeometric+NorwegianRosemaling+EthiopianCrossLattice / IndianMughal+GeorgianMinonkari+AmericanArtDeco+MexicanTalavera / MoroccanZellige+FilipinoYakan+HungarianKalocsa+ChineseCizhou)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Iranian woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, bold and confident, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs, wide gold bands, dense tiered lotus-petal work) dominates one zone. Islamic geometric star-tile pattern (a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, wide gold bands, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile) dominates the second zone. Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork, wide gold bands, dense acanthus scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework, wide gold bands, dense lattice linework) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both arms raised overhead.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform high-heel mules, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, a hollow, dreamy expression, demure and soft, vivid copper-orange hair styled in wavy, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions, wide gold-and-crimson bands, dense jewel-toned scrollwork) dominates one zone. Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel (a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, wide gold bands, dense cloisonné floral wirework) dominates the second zone. American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst, wide silver chrome bands, dense zigzag linework) dominates the third zone. Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands, dense medallion scrollwork) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, a confident sparkling expression, bold and confident, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes. Long square nails, matte finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs) dominates one zone. Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands, wide magenta-and-gold bands, dense geometric diamond work) dominates the second zone. Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals, wide gold bands, dense folk-art floral motifs) dominates the third zone. Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands, dense leaf scrolls) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto corset-lace boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
